timeline.content: Interviewer opens the session; Alex introduces himself as a senior engineer with 6 years of experience.
timeline.summary: Interviewer: Thanks for joining us today. Alex: Senior software engineer, 6 years experience, most recently on Stripe's payment infrastructure team using Go and Kubernetes.

timeline.content: Alex explains what drew him to the role — real-time data pipelines and the engineering culture.
timeline.summary: Interviewer asked what drew Alex to the role. Alex: Excited about the work on real-time data pipelines; Kafka, Flink, and React are exactly where he wants to grow; admires the engineering culture in San Francisco.

timeline.content: Alex describes leading a monolith-to-microservices migration at Stripe, cutting latency 40% and saving $200k/year.
timeline.summary: Interviewer asked about a challenging project. Alex: Led migration from monolith to microservices; reduced latency 40%, cut infra costs ~$200k annually; hardest part was coordinating across 8 teams with different timelines.

timeline.content: Alex recounts a 20-minute production outage caused by a misconfigured service in week 3 of the migration.
timeline.summary: Interviewer asked about setbacks. Alex: Major incident in week three — misconfigured service caused 20-minute outage; acknowledged should have pushed for more thorough testing; drove adoption of canary rollout procedures after the incident.

timeline.content: Alex describes how he handles disagreements with managers — leading with data, not opinion.
timeline.summary: Interviewer asked about handling manager disagreements. Alex: Comes with data; disagreed with Stripe manager about feature vs reliability priority; presented on-call burden metrics; compromised — reliability work came first.

timeline.content: Alex shares his 3-year vision: leading a platform infra team of 5–8 engineers, targeting Staff Engineer or EM track.
timeline.summary: Interviewer asked about 3-year plan. Alex: Wants to lead a small engineering team (5–8 people) on platform infrastructure; still exploring Staff Engineer vs Engineering Manager path.

timeline.content: Alex asks about on-call rotation, technical debt management, and the Senior→Staff progression path.
timeline.summary: Interviewer asked if Alex had questions. Alex: Asked about on-call rotation structure, approach to technical debt, and whether a clear Senior→Staff path exists.

timeline.content: Interviewer closes the session; both parties express mutual appreciation.
timeline.summary: Interviewer: Great questions, we'll cover all of that with the team. Thanks so much, Alex. Alex: Thank you, really enjoyed the conversation.
